assumptions.delay: one extra global valuation-session, all disclosure and market signals delayed
assumptions.regime: QQQ USD past 20 observed valuation dates, +/-3% plus MA20 confirmation; unknown during warmup
assumptions.contributions: sum of prior-NAV-weighted KRW holding P&L divided by initial NAV; fees separate
assumptions.remove_top_contributor: post-selection dependence diagnostic: removes the ex-post top contributing stock from the cached top10, refills only from remaining cached ranks; ranks11+ are not reconsidered, so this is not a fully reranked exclusion strategy
assumptions.fresh_start: cash on first holdout date, execute its close; cannot earn first-day pre-entry return
